Enter name, main destination, start and end dates, number of travelers (optional description)
Highlight invalid fields with an error message (NFR-3)

Show an error: the trip could not be saved (NFR-6)

Copy accommodation and transportation into the new trip

(temp file, then replace: R-01)

Create a Trip
Covers: US-01, US-08 (copy bookings) and US-14 (saving)

Precondition: the user is signed in and on the trip list
Postcondition: the trip is saved in trips.json with the user as Organizer
Open the itinerary and tap “Add Activity”
Enter title, date and start time (optional end time, location and notes)
Validate: required fields filled and date within the trip dates (FR-2.1, FR-2.2)
Show an error next to the field (NFR-3)
Show an overlap warning naming the other activity
Show the itinerary grouped by day and sorted by start time (FR-2.3)
Check other activities on the same day for a time overlap (FR-2.5)

Add an Activity
Covers US-04 (add, date check, overlap warning) and US-05 (itinerary grouped by day).

Precondition: the user is signed in, has the trip open and is its Organizer (Members can’t edit the itinerary: FR-5.4).
Postcondition: the activity is saved and shown under its day.
Activity 3 - Budget and Expense Tracking: Log an Expense
Enter amount, category, date and an optional note
Show budget, spent, remaining and the expense list (FR-3.3, FR-3.4)
Show an error next to the field (NFR-3)
Recalculate spent, remaining and category totals (FR-3.3, FR-3.4)
Validate (> 0) and save the new budget (FR-3.1)
Show the Budget screen with the updated totals
Save the expense to trips.json with addedBy = current user (FR-5.3, FR-7.1)

Log an Expense
Covers US-06 (log expenses) and US-07 (summary and overspend warning).

Precondition: the user is signed in and has a trip open. An Organizer or a Member can log expenses (FR-5.3).
Postcondition: the expense is saved and the totals are up to date.

If no budget has been set yet, the over-budget check takes the [no] branch.
Activity 4 - Accommodation and Transportation: Add a Booking
Open the trip’s bookings and tap “Add Booking”
Enter name, address, check-in and check-out dates (optional confirmation number)
Enter type (Flight, Train, Bus, Car Rental, Other), provider, from and to, departure and arrival times (optional confirmation number)
Validate: required fields, check-out after check-in, arrival after departure (FR-4.3)
Show an error next to the field (NFR-3)
Show the booking in the trip’s booking list and on the dashboard (FR-6.1)
Save the booking to trips.json with addedBy = current user (FR-5.3, FR-7.1)

Add a Booking
Covers US-08 (FR-4.1 to FR-4.3). Copying bookings from a past trip (FR-4.6) is in Activity Diagram 1.

Precondition: the user is signed in and has the trip open. Organizers and Members can both add bookings (FR-5.3).
Postcondition: the booking is saved, marked as added by this user, and listed on the trip.
Enter the person’s account email and tap Invite
Sign in to their own account (later, on the same device)
Show an error: no account with this email on this device
Show the pending invitation: who sent it and which trip (FR-5.2)
Show the shared trip in their trip list with the same itinerary, budget and bookings (FR-5.5)
Organizer sees “Declined” on the Members screen (US-10)
Find an account with this email on this device (FR-5.1)
Save an invitation with status PENDING
Add them to the trip as a Member; set status ACCEPTED (FR-5.3)
Set the invitation status to DECLINED

Invite Members
Covers US-10 (invite, then accept or decline).

Precondition: the Organizer is signed in and has the trip open. The invited person already has an account on this device.
Postcondition: the invitation is ACCEPTED (they see the shared trip) or DECLINED (the Organizer sees that).

Both people use the same device: the member sees the invitation the next time they sign in to their own account.
Activity 6 - Trip Dashboard: View a Trip’s Dashboard
Tap a trip in the trip list
Tap a section of the dashboard
Show the dashboard: name, dates, days until departure, next 3 activities, spent and remaining, upcoming bookings (FR-6.1)

View a Trip’s Dashboard
Covers US-13 (FR-6.1, FR-6.2, NFR-2).

Precondition: the user is signed in and the trip is theirs or shared with them (NFR-13).
Postcondition: the screen for the tapped section is open.

The black bars are a fork and a join: the four summaries are worked out in parallel, and the dashboard is shown once all four are ready. The other sections open their screens the same way.
Activity 7 - Data Storage: Load and Save Data
Add or change a trip, activity, expense, booking or account
Show an error message instead of crashing (NFR-6)
Keep all data in memory and show the Sign In screen (R-11)
Show an error: the change wasn’t saved; the last good file is kept (NFR-6)
Show the updated screen; the change survives a restart (NFR-4)
Read users.json and trips.json from the app’s private storage (NFR-12)
Write the data to a temporary file
Replace the original file and keep the previous version as a backup (R-01)

Load and Save Data
Covers US-14 (FR-7.1) with NFR-4, NFR-6, NFR-12 and risks R-01 and R-11.

Precondition: the app is installed; users.json and trips.json may or may not exist yet.
Postcondition: every change is written to the device, and a failed write never damages the last good file.

The save part runs after every change (new or edited trip, activity, expense, booking or account).
Activity 8 - User Accounts: Sign In, Create an Account or Reset a Password
Enter name, email, password, security question and answer; tap Create Account
Enter email and password; tap Sign In
Answer the security question and enter a new password
Show an error; stay signed out
Show an error: the answer doesn’t match
Show the user’s trip list: their own and shared trips only (NFR-13)
Hash the password and security answer; save the account to users.json (FR-8.1, NFR-14)
Find the account by email and compare the password hash (FR-8.2, NFR-14)
Check the answer hash; if correct, save the new password hash (FR-8.3)
sign in with the new password

Sign In, Create an Account or Reset a Password
Covers US-15 (FR-8.1 to FR-8.3) with NFR-13 and NFR-14.

Precondition: the app is open and nobody is signed in.
Postcondition: the user is signed in and sees only their own and shared trips.

Passwords and security answers are only ever stored and compared as hashes (NFR-14). Signing out returns to the Sign In screen.
